description: A copy of the r-fmt-1-accdb-empty fixture. A setup session builds An (ID COUNTER primary key PK, K LONG with unique index UK, S TEXT(50), D DOUBLE), empty; Src (N primary key, G, K, S, L TEXT(20)) with group 1 K 1-4, group 2 K 11, 12, 12, 13 (S 'g2-b-first12' and 'g2-c-second12'), group 3 K 31-34 (33 makes 1 / (K - 33) divide by zero), group 4 L '41', '42', 'x43', '44'; and U (ID primary key, K LONG with unique index UKU, S) with rows (1,1), (2,2), (3,3), (4,4). The setup session closes, and after a 1000 ms pause the statement session opens the database through DAO (shared, read/write) and runs: No flag: INSERT INTO An (K, S) VALUES ('x', 'conv'). RecordsAffected and DBEngine.Errors are read after the statement, then a 1500 ms pause separates its deferred write from Close. After each session the file is read page by page (every page's hash; page 0 bytes 3584-3591 and pages 0, 1, 42, 43, 44, 45, 50, 51, 52, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57 kept). A next session runs INSERT INTO An (K, S) VALUES (1000, 'next') with dbFailOnError (page 42 kept after it), and a read-only session reads An and U back. With the ETW file-I/O recorder on. Asks which rows are stored with which AutoNumber values, what the TableDef counters and row counts hold, which bytes are written and when.
retentionNote: r-q18 statement publication: rows, TableDef counters, page-0 counter and ETW write groups of one statement (task sjws/tc26)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UK ON An (K)
